# Cube.AttributeMemberId

```m
Cube.AttributeMemberId(attribute as any) as any
```

Returns the unique member identifier from a member property value. `attribute`. Returns null for any other values.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `attribute` | `any` | no |
